mostWorthwhile.text: Turning a remembered animal into an imagined beast made the creative process tangible: familiar features could be rearranged into something new.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment was a straightforward preparation rather than an interesting decision, although it made physical sense.

surprise.text: The remembered animal painting was not itself the imaginary animal; adding a story created the invented beast.

arbitrary.text: Echo plus memory producing a song felt somewhat compressed: the explanation connects repetition to rhythm, but the leap to a song was quick.

continue.text: I might continue: the chapter connected making and teaching to understandable processes, particularly the imagined beast, though the fast menu left little compatibility discovery.
